shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json && ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/ && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f \( -name "*.ts" -o -name "*.tsx" -o -name "*.js" -o -name "*.mjs" \) -print | head -50

cat next.config.ts app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx tsconfig.json; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/*/ | head -80; grep -ril "proxy\|middleware" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app --include=*.md -l | head

npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | grep -v next-env | head; (npx next dev -p 3123 > /tmp/dev.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 8; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3123/ ; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" "http://localhost:3123/missing?x=1"; sleep 2; cat /tmp/dev.log; pkill -f "next dev" || true
git status --short && git diff tsconfig.json && cat AGENTS.md | head -20
